verdict.rationale: Before applying, the published guidance names one identity-proofing step: verifying your identity and submitting documents through the UK Immigration: ID Check app. It also states up front that founders "must apply online", with separate in-UK and outside-UK flows. Nothing shows a full, published list of the account-creation, credential and identity-check steps before the flow begins. missing for 10: explicit pre-start documentation of account/sign-in requirements, credential types, biometric/appointment steps vs app-based ID check by applicant situation, an end-to-end prerequisite checklist on the founder route page, independent or hands-on corroboration that no walls are discovered mid-flow.
